ordering: Expected information gain per unit of risk. Item 1 gates every WHATIF_CALCULATE item; submit-dependent items come last.

experiments.title: Validate the no-save what-if channel on Certificate of Deposit
experiments.restore: Cancel (releases the modify lock; server state must show the original deposit)
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Confirms that calculate returns results without save, that Cancel restores state, and how long the lock lasts. Every later WHATIF item depends on this. Also identifies the CD interest function.

experiments.title: Fixed capacity option scan
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Gives the capital cost curve of capacity without saving. Also checks the client-side 65-day quarter constant against the server.

experiments.title: Production cost model via Factory Simulation planner (fallback: Open Stores)
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Per-brand material, labor and overhead per unit as a function of volume. This is the biggest server-opaque block of operating profit. The planner's saved values are planning inputs, which lowers the stakes.

experiments.title: Division profitability planner: estimated price
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Gives the server's accounting identity from price x demand to the division P&L lines, with demand held as an input. It separates accounting from the unknown demand model.

experiments.title: Operating capacity labor cost
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Gives direct labor and overhead cost per unit as a function of operating capacity.

experiments.title: Sales force hiring cost
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Gives the hiring, employment and layoff cost structure (cost side of the sales-force lever).

experiments.title: Local media insert cost
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Gives the advertising cost function (cost side of the advertising lever).

experiments.title: Short-term loan interest
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Gives the financing cost function. Also tests whether the rate depends on the loan size.

experiments.title: Save-then-ProForma: does the income statement projection follow saved decisions?
experiments.restore: Modify, enter the recorded original value, Save, then re-check the ProForma pages
evidence: ProFormaFinance view has no decision parameters (projection from stored state, INFERRED)
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Tests the inference that pro forma projections recompute from saved decisions. It is a real write that teammates will see, so it ranks below the no-save items.

experiments.title: Price response (demand model) - next quarter only
experiments.restore: Not reversible once the quarter is processed
experiments.info_gain_rationale: Demand response is the core unknown, but it gives one confounded observation per quarter (competitors move too). Do it only as a deliberate team decision.
